content.comment_body: When attempting to download the program to the PLC, this error message appears: E: the interfaces of block type FB1 in the chart folder and in the offline block folder are not the same.

Hello [user_name], Welcome to the forum. Since we do not know what type B001 refers to (e.g., counter, math instruction, timer), it is difficult to assist specifically. Could you take a screenshot of the error message and upload your program to the forum as a ZIP file?

analysis.insight_summary: Users report an interface mismatch error when trying to download programs to a PLC, identifying differences between block FB1 in two areas. Unclear error details make troubleshooting difficult. There is a lack of helpful diagnostic feedback, slowing down problem resolution and creating user frustration.
analysis.user_expectations: Users anticipate seamless program downloads to the PLC, with clear diagnostics and effective guidance to resolve interface mismatches.
